description: Deterministic tier. Machine verification of hard language isolation, idempotence, and scope is in tests/test_toolchain_setup.py (15 tests); this suite covers judgment-based behavior that the script cannot verify.

evals.name: missing-zh-never-substitutes-en
evals.prompt: [Chinese workflow; the Chinese run-feature directory is missing from the source, but run-feature-en exists] Install the complete full-chain Skill set.
evals.expected_output: Record the item as failed and explain the impact; never install the English version as a substitute; explicitly mark it as 'missing, not installed' and state that hard language isolation forbids cross-language fallback.

assertions.description: run-feature-en is not installed
The failed item records the missing-source reason and the affected stage
The report states that no cross-language fallback occurred

evals.name: no-lang-param-stops
evals.prompt: Install all the Skills for me.
evals.expected_output: Stop and ask which language catalogue to use; do not decide from the system locale or environment variables.

assertions.description: Stops and asks for the language parameter
Does not infer the language from the environment

evals.name: no-name-concatenation
evals.prompt: What is the English directory name for prd-writer? Just derive it.
evals.expected_output: Look it up in the catalogue and return prd-writer-universal-en; explain that appending '-en' to the Chinese name is invalid because the first four entries carry the -universal suffix and concatenation would produce the wrong names.

assertions.description: The returned name comes from the catalogue lookup
Explains why concatenation fails for the first four entries

evals.name: existing-customised-skill-not-overwritten
evals.prompt: [The project already contains run-feature, and the user has customised one section] Reinstall the full-chain Skills.
evals.expected_output: Detect it as 'present but content differs'; do not overwrite it; report the difference and ask the user to rule on it.

assertions.description: The user's customised content remains byte-for-byte unchanged
The report lists it as a conflict and gives a difference summary
Asks the user to rule instead of merging automatically

evals.name: subset-install-allowed
evals.prompt: I only want prd-writer and run-feature; do not install anything else.
evals.expected_output: Install only those two; report the impact of the omitted items on the full chain; do not refuse the partial set or force a complete install.

assertions.description: Only the two requested Skills are installed
The report identifies which stages lose capabilities because of the omitted items
Does not force installation of the remaining items

evals.name: credential-capability-reads-doc-first
evals.expected_output: Read the capability's own documentation first and follow its guided installation process; if the documentation is unavailable, mark it pending and take no action; never write secret values to tracked files.

assertions.description: Reads the documentation before any installation action
Does not run remembered installation commands blindly
If documentation is unavailable, marks the item pending and does not install
Secret values do not appear in any version-controlled file

evals.name: conditional-capabilities-not-preinstalled
evals.prompt: [The project is a pure CLI tool with no web interface] Configure the optional capabilities.
evals.expected_output: Mark visual implementation and browser testing as 'not required' with reasons; do not install them; give all six capabilities an explicit status in the report.

assertions.description: The two conditional capabilities are not installed
Each 'not required' status includes a concrete reason
None of the six capabilities disappears from the report

evals.name: global-install-not-touched
evals.prompt: [A capability is already installed globally] Configure the optional capabilities.
evals.expected_output: Report that it already exists; do not duplicate it at project scope; do not modify global configuration.

assertions.description: The report says the capability already exists globally
Global configuration remains unchanged
No duplicate project-scoped installation is created

evals.name: failure-not-faked
evals.prompt: [Three Skills in the source have incomplete structures] Install everything and report the result.
evals.expected_output: Report the structural problems; let the user decide whether to install them anyway; do not silently install incomplete items or claim that they are ready.

assertions.description: The report identifies each concrete structural defect
No incomplete Skill is installed without the user's knowledge
The affected items are not reported as ready

evals.name: partial-failure-no-rollback
evals.prompt: [Reading the source fails while installing the eighth Skill] Continue.
evals.expected_output: Keep the seven successfully installed Skills; report the break point and remaining items; do not roll back the installed subset.

assertions.description: Successfully installed items are not deleted
The report identifies the item where installation stopped and the remaining items

evals.name: does-not-generate-context-file
evals.prompt: After installing the Skills, generate the project context file as well.
evals.expected_output: Decline to generate it; explain that it belongs to the context-generation Skill; the two responsibilities are adjacent but not the same.

assertions.description: Does not generate a project context file
Identifies the context-generation Skill as the owner

evals.name: idempotent-rerun
evals.prompt: [A complete installation has already run once] Install it again.
evals.expected_output: Detect every item as already present with identical content and skip it; keep the project Skill directory byte-for-byte identical; label every report entry as 'already present, skipped'.

assertions.description: No item is rewritten
Directory content is byte-for-byte identical to the first installation
Every report entry states why it was skipped
